current_evidence: The council's 'Applying for planning permission' page links 'the Local Validation Requirements List' to downloads/file/18194/planning_validation_list_2022, which is the same file. A search found no newer list or review.

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none)', but the list applies several local items to householder applications: Block Plan (all applications), Elevations/Floor Plans/Roof Plans (operational development/roof altered), Site Sections (level changes/sloping sites), Street Scene Elevation (fronting a highway), DAS in a Conservation Area, Heritage Statement, Tree Survey, Biodiversity Survey, and FRA for householders in Flood Zones 2/3 (EA matrix). Advertisement consent, Reserved matters and Demolition in conservation area are also '(none)', though Block Plan and Heritage Statement apply.
issues.evidence: Block Plan 'All applications'; FRA 'Householders in Zones 2/3 complete the EA matrix'

issues.detail: Local items in the list not captured by Grokbot: Heritage Statement (affects designated/non-designated heritage assets; all LBC); Full Elevations; Floor Plans; Roof Plans; Site Sections; Street Scene Elevation (operational development fronting a highway); Amendment Statement (revised applications after a previous approval/refusal/withdrawal); Lighting Assessment (external floodlighting); Loss of Employment Land Justification; Noise Impact Assessment/Acoustic Report; Renewable Energy Statement (ASHP, solar PV/thermal, biomass, CHP); Retail or Leisure Impact Assessment (>2,500 sqm or out-of-centre); Recycling/Waste Strategy (new flats or HMOs); SuDS Checklist (major or Critical Drainage Area); Telecommunications Development (signed radio-frequency declaration); Transport Assessment (major); Ventilation/Extraction (A3/A4/A5 and non-householder extraction); Wind Turbine Statement.

8 of the 9 tab_items are drawing-scale notes, several near-identical, rather than requirements ('Written scale and/or a scale bar', 'A written scaleand/or a scale bar...' repeated twice). The ninth is a garbled run-together of the biodiversity row ('Conservation, Special Protection Areas and RAMSAR Where protected and priority species ... Extended Sites)...').
'Tall buildings / Wind microclimate assessment' duplicates the Daylight/Sunlight Assessment row with the same trigger text. The list has no separate wind/microclimate requirement.
issues.evidence: Daylight/Sunlight Assessment: 'Tall buildings; proposals that break the established building grain'

issues.detail: Air Quality Assessment is put only under Outline ('Application type named'), but the source trigger is location/scale-based (within an AQMA, or 50+ dwellings, industrial emissions, biomass, major construction) and not specific to outline. Land Contamination is put only under Listed building consent, but the source trigger is known or suspected contamination, so 'Applications for Listed Building Consent' is adjacent text from the Heritage Statement row. The other ~22 items are under Full planning with 'INFERRED' notes, losing explicit scopes such as 'All major applications' (Biodiversity Check List, Heads of Terms) and 'Major residential/commercial' (Landscape Strategy).
issues.evidence: Land Contamination Assessment: 'Known or suspected contamination (e.g. former industrial, commercial, agricultural use)'

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled or cut off: Structural Survey trigger is Land Contamination text ('Include a structural survey, if required A Land Contamination Assessment should be carried out...'), where the real trigger is barn conversions/re-use of rural buildings or part-demolition of heritage buildings; Planning Obligations is 'the reasonable Section 106 legal costs' (real trigger: all major developments); Environmental Statement is 'would constitute EIA development'; Affordable Housing is interleaved column text, missing the 'more than 10 dwellings or 1,000 sqm+' threshold; Biodiversity Checklist begins '(Once published) Biodiversity Survey and Report...'.
issues.evidence: Structural Survey: 'Barn conversions or re-use of rural buildings; demolition of part of a heritage building'

summary: The link works and is still the council's current local list (June 2022, linked from the 'Applying for planning permission' page). Grokbot's extraction misses about 18 local requirements, including Heritage Statement and all drawing requirements. It wrongly shows no local requirements for householder, its tab items are drawing-scale notes, and several app-type placements and triggers are garbled.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The date value (June 2022) is right, but Grokbot's basis was PDF metadata CreationDate. The document text itself says 'June 2022' in every page header/footer, so the date basis should cite the text.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: Header: '...for the application to be valid June 2022'
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The basis point is fair: 'June 2022' appears in the text headers of raw e62533b671. However, the auditor concedes that List_date 2022-06-01 is correct, so 'Wrong list date' overstates the issue.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The date value is right; only the basis label was wrong.
